notes.title: Financial v0.5.0
notes.content:
Hello employees! Momentous day! The latest version of Under Contract is now ready and we are excited to get you all playing. With this patch, the first version of Department 2 aka the first half of the Finance Department is ready to play!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283054/f41a648f4dcda4cec4fb74c977743f0b0f257059.gif[/img]
[h2]Money talks, and bullshit walks…[/h2]
The second department is MASSIVE. The first half of it which is ready to play as of this patch is the same length as the entire Marketing Department in terms of gameplay nodes and narrative. Let’s run down the specifics of what's been added.

[list]
[*] 25,000 words of dialogue
[*] 8 new sex scenes with finishing animations
[*] 2 new gem hazards
[*] 1 new upgrade power
[*] 2 new arcade levels
[*] 15 new arcade rewards
[*] 10 minutes of new music
[/list]
[h2]Three new demons are on the prowl[/h2]
The first half of the Finance Department comes with three new characters.

[h3]Sinder: Head of Fianance[/h3]
This pint-sized punk runs the Finance Department, her no-bullshit attitude is the reason the soul-conomy has only ever seen growth. What she lacks in stature she makes up for pushing her employees to their breaking point without purging what's useful about them. Expect long hours of cold-calling everyone walking the earth before she is satisfied.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283054/78ac651ec2ce54b40ce820681162d18774753e32.png[/img]
[h3]Puck and Mare: Minions extraordinaire[/h3]
The twin sister succubi turned sales reps make up the demon staff of the Finance Department. The twins are opposites to each other, one a boot licker, over-achiever, and sadist. The other is a lazy, incompetent, punk with a can-don’t attitude. Both will find creative ways to make the dosh and stand tall in front of Richard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283054/dfe10bf2e9d22b877695cd44738292aab44c4f5f.png[/img]
[h2]A new Dreamscape to explore[/h2]
The Finance Department has its overworld to explore! Climb the pyramid scheme and knock the boots out of the demonesses standing in your way! 50 new nodes to overcome, with two brand new hazards!

[list]
[*] Thorns: A standard gem, but a little spiker. If you’re careless and you grab this sucker, you’re in for a world of hurt.
[*] Combo: A gem with extra lives? Who’d a thunk? To clear a combo gem ya gotta combo that bad boi several times over.
[/list]
[h2]Changes and Fixes[/h2]
Along with the new content to explore sweeping changes have affected the full Under Contract experience! Some of the more notable changes and fixes include:

[list]
[*] Under Contract is now saving after every node is completed as the player enters the overworld screen. This should correct a lot of save file corruption bugs
[*] Arcade mode has additional checks for game stability crashes
[*] Gems no longer bounce off the bottom level if particular conditions are met
[*] Windowed Mode has additional fixes for the black border issue
[*] Green nodes now offer unique teleportation fast travel options along with a terminal screen for future content
[*] Shooter Minion hazard bullets can now destroy gems
[*] Shield Minion hazards have a new icon
[*] Richard's chibi has a slew of new victory chibi poses
[*] + Many many more!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283054/43f3beee71c8043521079f7bfa8ccaee9df6803d.png[/img]
[h2]Future Focus and Plans[/h2]
So some things are missing from Department 2. Our immediate plans will be focused on finishing up the department content. Here is a list you can expect from us, in no particular order.

[list]
[*] audio for sex scenes
[*] marketing department sex scene overhaul (it is already done just needs audio)
[*] coworker/boss dates (narrative, new outfits, sex scenes)
[*] arcade mode content (levels, coworker reward images)
[*] finance department coworkers and their date content
[*] finance department ending narrative
[*] human resources department boss model and poses done
[*] a handful of finance department ost tracks
[/list]
Once all of that is done, our focus will move on to building Department 3, Human Resources!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1972470/Under_Contract/

We hope you all enjoy this massive new update to the game, and we are eagerly awaiting your feedback!

notes.title: Dev Blog 06

[h2]Narrative Lock[/h2]
As of now, the Introduction for and first half of the Finance Department aka Department 2 aka Chapter 2 of Under Contract has been completed. The total word count comes in at just over [b]25,000 words[/b]. To put that into perspective, the entire game that is available to the public right now is only 30,000 words. This would make department 2 twice the size of department 1!

This was a joint effort with our writing staff and the art team to make sure it all came together cohesively. Also, we did way too much research on MLM and Pyramid Schemes to write the jokes we have, so we hope you all enjoy the content once it is ready. The next step is to push it all into the game, which means transcoding all that text into the game's LocKit. Then translation, and LQA.

We also will be updating the Arcade mode to include 15 new reward images for our new girls Sinder, Mare, and Puck! So look forward to that as well!

notes.title: Arcade Mode v0.4.7
notes.content:
Hello employees! Welcome to another update for Under Contract version 0.4.7! Today we have a brand new gameplay system added to the game along with a bunch of quality-of-life fixes and we squash some very difficult-to-find bugs.

[h2]Toss a Coin to your Arcade Machine[/h2]
Oh yes, the long-awaited day has arrived. We have now added our arcade mode to Under Contract! Within this mode, players can play levels as long as they like, find tokens in the game, and unlock new sexy selfies of all the characters in Under Contract!

So far we have three levels to choose from each containing new hazards and powerups to use. Go for that top score and try to unlock everything in the shop!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283054/847ee77f4994988b1a9f632892dcb83dcfcf73c0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283054/69488aaea92a7d5aaf6d4e9110304b944b18e7ca.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283054/8e3d0970a629549800f3e8323295130f31f763a2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283054/89acb507fd3a51c8bed7f3205ff4af7d8f1ef4fa.png[/img]

[h2]Bug Squashing Season[/h2]
The major reason this patch took so long to release was that we found a difficult-to-replicate bug, which some of the reviews on Steam seemed to reflect. Players would have their levels randomly end. For the life of us, the team could not find the cause for something like this, that was until we played in the arcade game mode.

It turns out that the game was allowing for players to grab falling gems after a cascade event triggers, if the player grabs them as they are falling the gems can sometimes combo in the hand of the player, or the player can grab mismatched gems (like a red and a yellow at the same time). If either event happens the level will just abruptly end.

This along with a bunch of other fixes have been added to the game!

[h2]Version 0.4.7 Changelog:[/h2]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] duplicate save file fix, for certain users the game would not auto save, this is now fixed.
[*] duplicate line drop fix, new lines would sometimes spawn twice, this is now fixed.
[*] large puzzles gem drop at start fixed, the beginning of large puzzle nodes would collapse gems randomly, this is now fixed.
[*] grabbing cascading gems is no longer possible, this is the cause of maps randomly ending the game early as a failure, this has been fixed.
[*] removed unity shootray and collision tech from gem handling.
[*] minions no longer shoot projectiles while they are off-screen.
[/list]
[b]New Mechanics[/b]
[list]
[*] combos no longer need to be next to each other to count towards the combo meter.
[*] minion projectiles scale increased for visibility.
[*] falling spikes scale increased for visibility.
[*] key icons for department 1 overworld added, this makes visibility on which nodes the player needs to beat to get the four keys to progress.
[/list]
[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*] arcade mode added, this can be accessed from the main menu.
[*] three rounds added to arcade mode.
[*] sex shop added to arcade mode, 35 images in total added to the shop, there are five for each character.
[/list]

[h2]Future Patches[/h2]
I wanted to take a quick moment to first thank everyone for their patience as we fix up some of these annoying bugs. It has been a while since we patched and we intended to get this one out a lot sooner than we did. Having said that, the next patch is going to be focused on the beginning section of Department 2, aka the Finance Department. Let me just run down some details on what we are doing and the full extent of the content aiming to be in the next patch.

[list]
[*] 3 new characters have been modeled and added to the game (Sinder, Mare, and Puck).
[*] 53 new gameplay nodes for the beginning area of the Finance Department.
[*] 18,000+ words for the intro and new narrative elements.
[*] 8 fully animated sex scenes.
[*] Reworking all sex scenes from Department 1 to increase the quality and framerate.
[*] Add missing cum scenes from Department 1 standard reward scenes.
[/list]
Lots of new content for sure, I would say as a percentage we are mostly done with the narrative, and just focusing on the animations and such.

We hope you all enjoy the new patch! And I hope you can all hold out until the new wave of content is in, we are working hard to get it done ASAP!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1972470/Under_Contract/

Thanks,
Kinky

notes.title: Dev Blog 05
notes.content:
Hello employees! We have been hard at work putting together everything we need for the second Department of Under Contract, and I wanna share our progress with you all! Just as a side note though, the team is kinda split between two major camps of work. The first is the programming and mechanics/systems development, and the second is narrative and art. The second Department is mostly a job for narrative and art, both take time to get right. So a new patch is due very soon to help you all with the wait which focuses on adding the “arcade mode” to the game with a very sizable sex gallery to unlock as you play through the new mode.

Okay! On with the progress!

[h2]Behind a Girl Boss is a bigger, badder, Girl Boss[/h2]
Let’s introduce the new manager for the Finance Department. Her name is Sinder and she is going to be a whole lot of trouble. Overseeing the money-making schemes within the cultperation her job is to incentivize those under her to incentivize those under themselves. Souls are worth way more than any Monkey JPGs or Gumball Anime Tiddie GIFs, so when Richard is pushed into her domain, she can only take it personally.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283054/8dfedd743435449a3d3deae57774b35a225eaa46.png[/img]

Following her every move will be two new minions, both are still in development but here is a sneak peek of the first. They are designed to be twins, similar yet different. Unlike the nameless minions of the first department who were supposed to be numerous and uncountable, these two will be reappearing characters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283054/8647361f43825a5e58403312fb4f60ced4529a25.png[/img]
[h2]Help me, to help you, so you can help yourself…[/h2]
The Finance Department is one big Pyramid scheme joke. Expect a lot of references to modern money-making. Dropshipping, Digital Coins, NFT’s, Shorting, etc. And as such the department layout is in the shape of a pyramid! Funny right? Also very original.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283054/59e3f6c5e5b35a7a9d029170e973fc47814fd930.png[/img]

The 3D asset for the overworld is being crafted right now, so nothing super pretty to show so far.

[h2]Richard’s Shares[/h2]
Those who have given Bliss the hard shafting will know of Richard’s new shares, these will play an important role in the future of the game. This will come into play as you level up your companions. For the time being the fate of the shares is the major focus for the Department 2 introduction. This has already been written, along with the video work for a new scene already completed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283054/daf43b03f8daa3c4006c0eb62f623b0268aa5f2a.png[/img]
[h2]Arcade and Stills[/h2]
As I mentioned above, the next update to Under Contract will focus on the arcade mode which can be found on the main menu. This game mode is kinda an unlimited-style game, where levels can be played for as long as you like, doing so raises the level and the difficulty. Set your own high scores and play to find and grab as many “tokens” as possible. You can spend this currency in the “token shop”, here you can find 35 still sex images of all the current characters engaged in various hellish dickings. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283054/4999ef0548d6eedf327f01bd45a414a1df18c3c5.png[/img]

As we add new characters to Under Contract they will also get their own stills in this mode to unlock. Here is a small sample of some of the images you can unlock via the system.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283054/fbf3fbdb437ad2b1a6304b0c527c9034084fb43a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283054/329f8294aedfab6942a8a6d5cb8256421ef09227.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1972470/Under_Contract/

notes.title: Gems of Power v0.4.6
notes.content:
Hello employees! It is patch day for Under Contract and version 0.4.6 is ready to blow you away with our new enhancements to the base game formula! 

[h2]New Powers[/h2]
Every playable character in Under Contract now has the opportunity to level up and unlock a brand-new power gem! Here is how it works. 

Every level you beat with your chosen companion gives them 10 experience points and 3 additional points for beating a level on Hard Difficulty. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283054/7cd5073f373828257062380587c8ab0a62612cad.gif[/img]

To level up to level 2 with the chosen character you need to collect a total of 150 experience. Once you have enough that character on the party tab will be highlighted showing they are ready to level up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283054/1051adb6db6a9c719ab42e6c36daa5fbb35febdc.png[/img]
Getting a new power will have you spinning on the roulette of possible combinations. Those current combinations are Yellow, Blue, Red, and Green color removal, Horizontal and Verticle line clear. We do plan to add more later once we get a better feel for the powers in the game. Things like a bomb gem, or something of the like.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283054/42545bb5de7d54f856dc943450a1e7c1f79714eb.gif[/img]

Once unlocked, both new gems will begin appearing in the puzzle levels! We are still considering VS mode power gems, and if they even have a place in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283054/239060f6eb8735eb33e918bee007d0e0796d76f8.png[/img]
[h2]Rush Mode for Hard Difficulty[/h2]
The last big feature added to version 0.4.6 is the new Hard Mode conclusion system called Rush Mode. This will increase the speed of the line drops as you near the end of the level, increasing the pace at which you need to play. We felt that those who enjoy playing on the hardest difficulty did not really see much change to their gameplay as the pace at which experienced players can clear levels is staggering. We hope this makes it a little more enjoyable for those looking to challenge themselves!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283054/9633d42d41d6d0ffd0af5e237b3dd536ce756b40.gif[/img]

There were also a fair number of smaller fixes added in this patch, mostly focused on increasing load times based on the Unity video player which we use for transition animations.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1972470/Under_Contract/

We hope you all enjoy the new patch!

notes.title: Dev Blog 04
notes.content:
Hello employees! Welcome to another dev blog for Under Contract.

This will just be a quick post today to go over what we are working on right now, and the result of this is going to be the focus for the next patch of the game.

[h2]Level up your coworkers![/h2]
Coming in v0.4.6 is the leveling system for Richard and any coworkers he rescues on his climb to the top of the company. The basics are that beating any level in Under Contract will reward the active party member experience points. Reaching the cap will increase their level and unlock new powerful gems that will appear within the puzzle mode experiences.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283054/7cd5073f373828257062380587c8ab0a62612cad.gif[/img]

Depending on the difficulty you select you’ll receive different amounts of EXP with the most being given on hard mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283054/0af4d4a8fb5878ba99783aa910782422a0c18752.png[/img]

The system is in place right now to start accumulating the experience points for your party members however additional systems need to be built before the new power can unlock. Currently, we are testing just what the second powers will be, and offering a randomized gem color and power for the second unlock is kinda the direction we are heading.

Reaching level 2 will also spawn another character-related cutscene, allowing Richard to date his coworkers.

[h2]Rush Mode[/h2]
As the rewards for Hard mode are increasing, we wanted to add something a little more chaotic into the game mode. Rush Mode is something that will drastically increase the speed of line drops near the end of each puzzle mode, creating a far more climactic ending to each node Richard plays. This is ONLY available in Hard Mode.

[h2]Computer Nodes[/h2]
Lastly, we have begun work on creating an interactive computer system within Under Contract. Visiting the free “green” nodes will allow Richard to access his work computer. Inside the system will be an email application for receiving more world-building narratives, sexy selfies from your coworkers and bosses, a fast travel system to other unlocked green nodes, and other related services. We will have more to share with this soon!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1972470/Under_Contract/

Looking forward to hearing what you all think!

notes.title: Gallery of Smut v0.4.5
notes.content:
Hello employees! Welcome to patch version 0.4.5! Our focus for this build is based on the massive amount of feedback our team received after our launch on Steam’s Early Access platform. So let’s jump into it!

[h2]A Gallery for Smut[/h2]
By far the biggest critical piece of feedback we received was on the missing gallery system for viewing unlocked reward scenes. Those of you with already unlocked scenes will have them ready to access the moment you boot up the new patch. The Gallery right now can only be accessed from the Main Menu of Under Contract, however, it will pull from all four save files to find which scenes have been unlocked.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283054/c0f29f7d7ef4b988c118a1218f281f6ff5e52fe4.png[/img]
This system actually took a bit of time to nail down, and we consider this our first iteration of the mechanic. Later we would like to have an individual save Gallery as well that will be accessible from the overworld map, and a degree of filtering on the scenes you have available.

[h2]Visibility Improvements[/h2]
The next upgrade is to the main cutscene system. Pressing the “H” key will now hide the UI during all cutscenes making it possible to view the full background or animation without anything being covered. Hitting any other button will bring the UI back. This key can also be rebound in the options menu if you’d like to use something else.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283054/863ec0b217274c6b93dda010924d17f98e65f6cb.png[/img]
[h2]Unlock Notifications[/h2]
Finally, the last major improvement that compliments the new Gallery system is the notifications on unlock. If you unlock lewd reward scenes or quest items the game will now notify you of something new being available. This should help players understand the mechanics a little easier.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283054/ac8e8c2f2b7cae66429a4412d3095ca5893b4646.png[/img]
[h2]Future Content and Patches[/h2]
The first few content patches after the Early Access launch are tied directly to user feedback, what our customers judge to be the most vital components needing to be addressed and updated. We will be keeping our eyes peeled for anything new you all want to see. However, I wanted to discuss what else we will be working on before building the second gameplay area otherwise known as the “Finance Department”.

[h3]Computer Access Node for accessing emails and unlocking companion selfies.[/h3]
This is quite an interesting one for us, we wanted to use the current “free” nodes on the map to act as computer terminals, that the player could access to read their emails. Inside would be world-building narratives, comedy spam with hell+office related mixed jokes, and the Managers writing Richard annoying things. On top of this having coworkers send lewd selfies as you play the game with them as your active companion.

[h3]Leveling/exp system for companions.[/h3]
Our goal with this is to make your active companion gain exp as you beat nodes with them, doing so will unlock powers and other things with them. Not sure on the specifics of this so far and it will likely get a lot of changes based on customer feedback.

[h3]Companion dating system.[/h3]
When you level up an active companion you’ll be able to go on dates with them, we will likely lock this content off until you beat the first Boss and get some of the company shares in your possession. For narrative reasons, it gives the first area a limited growth pool for companions as well. During the dates, you’ll be able to have a dialogue tree with the coworker, see them in their casual clothing, and generally do lewd things with them in unique places.

[h3]Fast travel nodes.[/h3]
At computer terminals, we want to make them double as fast travel points. This will become very handy once we get more departments in the game, as travel times will become long if you missed content in an earlier area of the game.

[h3]Gameplay Updates and Improvements.[/h3]
A big focus for us to hit our Early Access release milestones was to make sure the cutscene and rewards system was amazing and smooth. Because of this, we left a lot of gameplay improvements and optimizations on the table for later development. We will be working on bringing those into the game going forward.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1972470/Under_Contract/

We hope you all will enjoy the new update with the Gallery content unlocked! It was an absolute pleasure to read all the feedback and suggestions you all had. Under Contract will become an amazing gem in the Adult Game scene!

notes.title: Marketing Motherload
notes.content:
[h1]This is a copy of our v0.4.1 release post for early adopters over on Itch.[/h1]

Hello employees! A glorious day has arrived, the long-awaited mega update for Under Contract v0.4.1 is here! This patch's basic summary is that the first department is now 100% complete, with all nodes, cutscenes, and rewards. It's all there. We took a very long time to polish how this game works, refine the gameplay experience, go over the narrative with a fine-tooth comb, and generally make it as good as we can!

Let’s get into it!

[h2]What can you expect?[/h2]
This is an odd thing to talk about, as there are far too many changes, fixes, and updates to discuss each one. Instead, we will talk about what you can find inside the game.

[h3]Hours of content[/h3]
Since the Marketing Department is now done that means you can play all the way until you beat the first major boss of the game. Anything post her reward scenes are still a work in progress. Our gameplay is still based on the nostalgic titles of Magical Drop, and our gameplay will aim to satisfy.

[h3]Slayer of Demons and Maidens[/h3]
Found within the Marketing Department are a variety of characters to interact with. We have the legion of Demonic Minions hunting Richard across his dreams, the tormenting Manager Bliss and the CEO Dominique, along with the first three coworkers Monika, Tracey, and Kelly. All will have unique sexual scenes with each other and with Richard for players to uncover, 20 scenes in total, all of them animated!

[h3]Don’t go at it alone![/h3]
Under Contract now has unlockable companions to assist Richard on his journey through the underworld. Each character recruited offers a unique way to play the game with special activation powers and gemstones! This build has four companions to unlock.

[h3]Multilingual, ready to mingle[/h3]
The entire introduction and Marketing Department is fully supported in 10 total languages. English, Chinese (Simplified & Traditional), Japanese, Korean, Russian, Spanish, Italian, German, and French. We have a little bit of the UI to localize still, but it won’t affect your enjoyment of the game.

[h3]Players of all skill levels welcome[/h3]
While we pride ourselves on the stressful nature of our gameplay we also aim to be inclusive as possible for those looking more to our story and “plot” offerings. So the full game has three total difficulties Easy, Normal, and Hard. Meaning everyone can get through the game however they want!

[h3]Amazing beats to puzzle too![/h3]
A full original soundtrack of music can be found within Under Contract, the length currently totals 30 full minutes, we also have a unique slew of sound effects both in narrative and combat. The future includes a vocal overhaul of all cutscenes and combat encounters.

We are hoping you all thoroughly enjoy the new offerings of Under Contract, and we hope you all can get in touch and let us know your thoughts and feedback. We want to make the best game possible, so please let us know.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1972470/Under_Contract/

Cheers,
Kinky

notes.title: Under Contract Release date annouced!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Just a quick message letting you all know that Under Contact's Early Access release is coming [b]May 18th[/b]! We have worked long and hard to make the first early access build as good as it can be!

Here is what you can expect in the first build:

[h3]5 to 8 hours of content![/h3]
- Explore the first Department in its entirety and overcome the first "endowed" road bump on Richard's journey.
- Three difficulties mean everyone can find their ideal experience.
- A slew of different puzzles and gameplay effects to play and overcome.
- Uncover the narrative of Under Contact in 10 languages.
- "Slay" your way through the Demon army with solo and group battles.

[h3]Enhance your game with companions![/h3]
- Find your favorite way to play by unlocking companions whose powers change how you play.
- Get to know your coworkers. Kelly, Tracy, and Monika are all trapped within the Dreamscape, battle your way to free their souls. I am sure they will love you for it!

[h3]High-quality "plot" animations to behold![/h3]
- The first department contains 19 total lewd animations to uncover.
- Every scene is filled with details scene descriptions for maximum enjoyment.

notes.title: Under Contract Dev Blog 03
notes.content:
Whew, lad, it's been a while since we updated this blog. Not to say we have not been busy, just that, well, I forgot to keep everyone updated on the game's development. My bad. Needless to say, we have been super super busy getting things together for a MASSIVE patch to the game, whenever we thought we were close we updated something that required a lot of attention elsewhere before we could make a public build.

Soooo yeah, here is the update!

[h2]Localization and Languages[/h2]
This is a massive upgrade to the base game of Under Contract. We are now supporting 10 total languages across the entire game! It was not easy to get it together, and we will likely be running into some problems with the languages (since we only speak English), so if you find anything in your playthroughs that seem wrong please let us know!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283054/f3844b0fd03d62e956aac5e7321b191f2d88021f.png[/img]

The Languages that are now supported are:
[list]
[*] English
[*] Chinese (traditional/simplified) 
[*] Japanese
[*] Korean
[*] Russian
[*] Spanish
[*] Italian
[*] German
[*] French
[/list]
To add this we had to rework our font system along with finding all the supported font types we needed to make the game work well. Then all the resizing and font placement. Not to mention remaking boxes and such to make everything fit.

[h2]Companion System[/h2]
Another massive reworking of our base game mechanics is the Companion System. Simply put any rescued coworkers (and others) will now be available to be Richard’s companion during his nighttime adventures in the Dreamscape. Eventually, this will be expanded with EXP growth for more special abilities and a dating system to further flesh out the characters and give unlockable scenes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283054/5b8865838412d41f075cabe1b995fdd747ab5a8e.png[/img]

Speaking about special abilities each character will have three possible powers to use in the game, we have completely removed the “ray gun” from the game and made all mana gems the ability gems instead. Combining these activates whatever power you’ve selected for each character.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283054/74411812333a133ab2e63550afa37d9fe52ccf89.png[/img]

[h2]Narrative Overhaul and Sexy Introduction[/h2]
Feedback is important to us, and one of the biggest piece of feedback we got was related to how much sex content is available in the game, along with how far you need to go to unlock and or see that content. 

To remedy this we have the following upgrades:
[list]
[*] All minion battles now have an animated with audio effects scene.
[*] We now have real-world “reality” scenes where characters are tormented in the office by their Demon bosses, which are animated with audio effects.
[*] A new game introduction has Richard meeting a particular character a little earlier for a wet dream sequence which is animated with audio effects.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283054/bd5f38780638b848e1bd4ac898c3357e01d11900.png[/img]

In the future we will add the following:
[list]
[*] Characters will be able to date each other starting in Chapter 2, which unlocks more sex scenes as well.
[*] An email system will be added to the game allowing for more world-building and character selfies to be awarded as unlocks.
[/list]
We also have introduced a new variety of cosmetics characters that can be found throughout the game, we are also considering making these unlockable for character customization.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283054/cabf6dbdc65bc5f13817312466c0bbb842be9394.png[/img]

This can also be seen in our world-building systems, with the chibi characters on the overworld and in your party being animated and going about their business more frequently.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283054/db0fb47f0400a948d6aa03c1b32fc3263e2b7414.png[/img]

Before we launch the next build there are other things we want to add still. Here is a quick-fire list to get you all up to speed.

[list]
[*] Difficulty selection: Easy, Normal, Hard.
[*] Voiced characters: Auditions are open right now for the roles, we hope to find our actors soon!
[*] Companion EXP system for unlocking new abilities.
[*] The conclusion to Department 1.
[*] A new demo with far more exploration options to make demo replays more interesting.
[/list]
So we are close! So very close. Thank you all for being very patent with us as we build the best game we can!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1972470/Under_Contract/

Cheers,
Kinky

notes.title: Group Action!
notes.content:
[h1]This is a copy of our v0.2.2 release post for early adopters over on Itch.[/h1]

Hello contractors! Welcome to another patch for Under Contract version 0.2.2! The game is coming along at a nice pace now, with our focus mostly on completing the first department blocking as soon as possible. 

Introducing the first pass on Circle 4 of the Marketing Department

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283054/ca16dfb4ab4e5ad5c7274e216f2c46f344d88794.png[/img]

This circle includes:

[list]
[*] 1 completed Reality Scene and another Reality Scene which is under construction
[*] 4 Group VS matches
[*] New obstacle Spike
[*] New obstacle Solid Block
[/list]
[b]Group Verse Matches[/b]
The new verses mechanics is something we have been working on since the very inception of the game itself. Originally we built it as a way to stress test the AI in the game by having 100 opponents race until they break, this boiled down to a very stressful, yet, highly engaging combat scenario. Two Demon Minions attack the player at once, and you’ve gotta beat them both back!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283054/4077b2b2693a0515801c510ead6e534f99aa6cc3.gif[/img]

To assist with this, the player can combo against shield gems which will block new lines sent to the player. You can stack up to three shields at once.

In future patches, expect the rewards to also include two lovely Demon Minions ‘rewarding’ Richard. For now, we have temporary text, but it is being worked on!

[b]Spikey Obstacles[/b]
As we were building this obstacle, we fell in love with it! The Spike Gem is way too much fun. While the concept is simple - gem drops, if it touches Richard he will be stunned - in practice the gameplay is really really fun. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283054/cb4e627da3cab26f2f4e271e2bfd0436beaaabf2.gif[/img]

There really are a lot of nuances around this, and we will be building on the concept a lot more in future patches.

[b]Solid Obstacles[/b]
The last new game mechanic added in this patch is the Solid Obstacle, this is simply a gem that can never be removed by traditional means, and simply clutters up the play space. As more come in the more difficult the space becomes to clear.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283054/1e3459fa62aae1d1dfdf743ff2bd649eb5b02885.gif[/img]

[b]Changelog v0.2.2[/b]

[list]
[*] Added Circle 4 to Marketing Department.
[*] Added 23 new gameplay nodes.
[*] Added Group VS mechanics.
[*] Added Spike Obstacle mechanics.
[*] Added Solid Obstacle mechanics.
[*] Added 2 Reality Narratives.
[*] Added 3 Tutorials.
[*] Added 2 Narrative nodes.
[*] Fixed Localisation errors.
[*] Fixed Splash Screen error.
[*] Added Controller support functions.
[*] Added SFX Loop functionality.
[/list]
[b]Patches going forward![/b]
November is going to be a massive month for Under Contract. Cumminham our glorious modeler and animator will be spending the entire month building new characters, animations, scenes, and assets. This leaves us for the rest of this month blocking out the remainder of The Marketing Department, filling out the rest of the narrative, and building one or two more main mechanics.

Following the Marketing Department work will begin on the Finance Department, and along with it a focus on a new main gameplay loop. We will be looking to mimic the Money Puzzle Exchange system which is very similar to what we currently have. No promises if we ultimately decide against using it for consistency's sake, but it should be a good time.

Enjoy the new build!

Cheers,
Kinky

notes.title: Under Contract Dev Blog 02
notes.content:
Hello employees! Welcome to our second developer blog for Under Contract! We have a lot going on with development that I wanted to discuss. Hold onta ya butts!

After releasing the demo and doing the Steam Nextfest we received a lot of feedback, and numbers are our jam! So let's break down our audience and what our reaction to that will be. First, you should have some knowledge about how we value our customers and their types.

[b]Type A[/b]: These customers are after the smut, they are here to enjoy the porn. They are also the easiest to please, serve easy to access porn early and often.
[b]Type B[/b]: This customer enjoys narrative and porn, and is very likely the largest consumer of visual novel products, or low-complexity games. The way you serve these customers is via titillating narrative and themed content.
[b]Type C[/b]: These are your grinders, they will willingly kill 100 skeletons to unlock all the lewds in a game. These types are served by creating rewarding gameplay loops or offering hidden/grindable rewards.

In order to make the game more appealing to more customers, we need to even our representation of each of these audience groups. We estimate our audience to be made up of the following for the demo/first release.

[b]Type A[/b]: 2%
[b]Type B[/b]: 33%
[b]Type C[/b]: 60%

So how do you make all of this more appealing to each group? Just good old hard yakka, that's how! We need to build more content for each group, Type C we have in the bag, we are game developers by trade, so making something fun and engaging goes without saying. The B and C types need more care.

Let’s first approach the gameplay content and jazz it up! Currently, we have our protagonist, Richard, in the gameplay scene being a normal guy. It works fine for gameplay but we need more appeal for our core. Our answer to this is to build a companion system instead.

[h2]Companions[/h2]
As you play Under Contract and rescue your co-workers from damnation these fine ladies will team up with Richard to take on the underworld managers! Each companion will offer a unique power to use within the gameplay sections and will take time to charge. They will also be present in some cut scenes with unique dialogue lines for the situation.

Your default companion will be the lovely Frida, your guide through the Dreamscape and other things. After you’ve freed a co-worker you’ll have the option to swap them anytime you’re on the map screen.

They not only offer unique gameplay elements with their powers, and offer more narrative elements. The companions will also cheer Richard on during gameplay and present themselves on screen for your enjoyment!

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283054/b3d04e9277ceceb2e3e379d23e27d62515467284.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283054/bdc8aa5ebb5286a9f15d285a4e3a242182496485.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283054/9d840b6483b8f5d5a983da85bb8197dc40b4ed8a.png[/img]

Hopefully, this will better serve our audience looking for titillating content, the higher the combo you achieve the more sexual her reactions will become!

[h2]Narrative[/h2]
The other element that will be overhauled is adding in narrative breaks during the Dreamscape exploration. These will come into play as “reality” nodes, which, once activated, send Richard back to the real world for another grueling day in the office. The exception here is that every single reality node will offer a unique sexual encounter with characters. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283054/1728345535fc80d0fde1bcdbe1a3000c0cb49ce6.png[/img]

An example of this: “Tracy being spanked on her bare ass by Dominque during her employee performance review as Richard peeks in” or “Bliss asserting her dominance over the unruly Richard using her feet”. 

Lastly, we wanted to offer quick rewards for winning a VS battle with Minions, so a quick sex scene with Richard and a Minion as a reward for besting them in combat. We are not sure how best to implement these, but the idea is solid for sure.

All of this requires more art, more narrative, not to forget easy methods of re-watching unlocked content. Just more things to work on, for sure.

Those are our plans, I cannot wait for your feedback on all this.

Cheers,
Kinky

notes.title: Under Contract Dev Blog 01
notes.content:
Hello everyone! So right [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/undercontract/under-contract/]up until our Kickstarter[/url], we were working diligently to build a diverse and engaging demo for everyone to enjoy, something that would really show off what we aim to accomplish with Under Contract. And now that the demo has been completed I wanted to take the time to show off our future plans for the game, and very likely address some questions you might have about the variety and direction the game will be going in.

[h1]Variety is the Spice of Life[/h1]
The original pitch for Under Contract had the player navigating an overworld map, similar to that of Super Mario Bros 3, with multiple courses the player can play and ignore depending on their likes and dislikes of the gameplay types we offer. We showed a few concepts for levels in the demo namely:

[list]
[*] General puzzles
[*] VS level
[*] Boss VS level
[*] Large panel general puzzles
[/list]
But that is not nearly enough to fill up our ideal 10+ hour campaign. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283054/21c630ecf0a29189b9710570429245713f9b3cee.png[/img]

Pictured here is a few of the overall concepts for in-game mechanics, special gem effects, modes, boss mechanics, and side levels we are looking to produce. On top of playing with our diverse AI gameplay where we can have up to 99 AI fighting each other at once (don’t worry we won’t make a battle royale level haha), there is going to be a lot of variety and substance in our campaign.

[h1]Narrative and Rewards[/h1]
So we have our overall narrative is woven already, it's roughly 40 pages of dialogue narration and scene setup. Our original design was to keep reward scenes to boss battles but [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/undercontract/under-contract/]during the Kickstarter setup[/url] we actually found a really nice groove to be in for what I would consider “mini rewards”. Special scenes are unlocked by finding secrets among other things.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283054/1dd6c724f4e53288a73e1769e14ea232f3fd1e07.png[/img]

It is a fun little exercise, so we will likely be expanding our content offerings as a result. This is all in part due to our fantastic art pipeline we established during the demo development, meaning things like this are fast and easy to produce, so why not produce a lot more of them?

The post demo production is about to begin this week, and I can guarantee that we will have a lot more to talk about over the next 30 days as we build up [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/undercontract/under-contract/]our campaign on Kickstarter[/url]. Be sure to back and support us over there and help us build our dream game!

If you have not already done so, please back our game on Kickstarter! The campaign just started and we need everyone's support to make this game sing!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/undercontract/under-contract/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283054/347ff360aa1be0a980c16d528a6ac4f10716b963.png[/img][/url]

Thank you for the support!
